description:
Our team is focused on innovation, collaboration, and creating meaningful solutions using NASA's open data. We aim to combine technology, creativity, and problem-solving to tackle real-world challenges.

We welcome people from different backgrounds, including AI, software development, data science, design, research, and storytelling. More important than experience is the willingness to learn, contribute, and work as a team.
summary: Our project consists of using the maps already provided by NASA and incorporating extremely important factors for survival on Mars. The points we took into consideration are: Climate, Temperature, Radiation (Solar Incidence), Places known and explored by rovers, dynamic maps with elevations, and the use of warm lights to reduce the map's energy consumption. With the use of NASA data, our entire program extracts real information that is made available and kept up-to-date. The main places where rovers have landed and explored get more attention on our map, because our focus is on the astronauts' total safety, and knowing the area well is the most important factor to make sure nothing unexpected happens.
details:
Our project ensures better safety for astronauts during exploration on Mars.

The program provides information on weather and temperature conditions, known locations, storm forecasts, and terrain geography with depressions and peaks.

Easy to use, low energy consumption, high accuracy in terrain geography, and easy to update.

Make it easier for astronauts to know and be aware in dangerous environments.

We generally use VS Code to run code, and we use various programming languages: JSX, CSS, JSON, Python, and R, as well as some libraries like React and Leaflet.

We thought about using red themes and warm colors to reduce energy consumption, that was the most creative part of our work, because it's not something we programmed, it's just physics, pure and applied.

The factor we took into account the most was the practicality of using the map to find out important things, we added several filters, each one providing information about something happening around.
